_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate and non-triggering liquidity/MVRV keep the honest call as HOLD into the adjacent Complacency rung unless a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD medium; narrative gives no forward phase or direction
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 40-55, BTC rangebound, ETF flows near zero, no funding flush
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with 30d momentum positive (up break) or F&G under 35 with vol spike and funding flush (down break)
